references.text: Mark 10:7 quotes directly from Genesis 2:24, where the principle is established that a man shall leave his parents and hold fast to his wife.
Mark 10:7 and Matthew 19:5 share the same quote from Genesis 2:24, emphasizing the importance of marital unity.
Ephesians 5:31 repeats this principle from Genesis 2:24, which Mark 10:7 also refers to, to explain the relationship between Christ and the church in the context of marriage.
